29194.meaning1: thought; thinking; reasoning; logic; speculation; conjecture

examples.text: yo kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā vacīsaṅkhāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo ariyo anāsavo lok'uttaro maggaṅgo.
kasmā nu saccāni vadanti nānā, pavādiyāse kusalā vadānā, saccāni sutāni bahūni nānā, udāhu te takkam'anussaranti.

29199.meaning1: logically forged; hammered out by reasoning; beaten together by speculation
29199.commentary: (DNa) takkapariyāhatan'ti takkena pariyāhataṃ, tena tena pariyāyena takketvā'ti attho.

examples.text: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
